reviews.author: Kenya W.
reviews.text: this might be my new favorite work spot. the most beautiful aesthetic, Mekenzi and Zane were so helpful & gave me a tour of all the different drink options. everything is non-alcoholic which I LOVE! highly recommended if you want a quiet place to work and good non-alcoholic drinks to enjoy
